Battery Module Assembly.name: Lithium
Battery Module Assembly.reasoning: Primary energy storage element in lithium-ion battery cells within the module, absolutely essential for battery function with no viable substitutes at commercial scale.

Battery Module Assembly.name: Cobalt
Battery Module Assembly.reasoning: Used in cathode material to provide high energy density and stability, a standard choice though some alternative cathode chemistries exist.

Battery Module Assembly.name: Nickel
Battery Module Assembly.reasoning: Common cathode material for energy density and cycle life; widely used though proportions vary.

Battery Module Assembly.name: Copper
Battery Module Assembly.reasoning: Essential electrical conductor for internal wiring and current collectors among cells, universally used.

Battery Module Assembly.name: Aluminum
Battery Module Assembly.reasoning: Used as current collector for cathode and structural support, standard in cell assembly.

Battery Module Assembly.name: Graphite
Battery Module Assembly.reasoning: Primary anode material for lithium-ion intercalation, universally used in commercial cells.

Battery Management System.name: Silicon
Battery Management System.reasoning: Fundamental semiconductor material for integrated circuits and microcontrollers within the BMS, universally essential.

Battery Management System.name: Copper
Battery Management System.reasoning: Extensively used in printed circuit boards and wiring as electric conductors, standard industry material.

Battery Management System.name: Aluminum
Battery Management System.reasoning: Used for heat sinks and structural parts due to good thermal conductivity and light weight; alternatives exist but aluminum is common.

Battery Management System.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Battery Management System.reasoning: Common polymer substrate for circuit board and insulation materials within the BMS, though alternatives like Polyimide can be used.

Battery Pack Enclosure.name: Aluminum
Battery Pack Enclosure.reasoning: Primary structural material for battery pack casing providing lightweight and strong protection, widely used in electric vehicle battery enclosures.

Battery Pack Enclosure.name: Steel Ingots
Battery Pack Enclosure.reasoning: Alternative or complementary structural material used for tougher or lower cost enclosures; moderate confidence due to multiple enclosure materials.

Battery Pack Enclosure.name: Polypropylene
Battery Pack Enclosure.reasoning: Polymer used in internal frame components or dampening parts inside enclosures; alternatives exist so moderate confidence.

Thermal Management System.name: Copper
Thermal Management System.reasoning: Primary material for thermal conductors such as heat pipes and cooling plates due to excellent thermal conductivity, almost universally used.

Thermal Management System.name: Aluminum
Thermal Management System.reasoning: Used in heat exchangers and cooling fins for lightweight and good thermal properties; common but less conductive than copper.

Thermal Management System.name: Polyethylene
Thermal Management System.reasoning: Used as insulation or piping material in coolant circuits, though other polymers may substitute; moderate confidence.

Electrical Busbars And Connectors.name: Copper
Electrical Busbars And Connectors.reasoning: Primary conductor material for busbars and connectors due to excellent electrical conductivity and reliability, an industry standard.

Electrical Busbars And Connectors.name: Aluminum
Electrical Busbars And Connectors.reasoning: Sometimes used as a lightweight conductor alternative to copper in connectors and busbars, less conductive but common.

Electrical Busbars And Connectors.name: Nickel
Electrical Busbars And Connectors.reasoning: Used as plating or coating on connectors to enhance corrosion resistance and contact quality; alternatives exist.
